name: email-download-attachment
description: Download an email attachment by its Nylas attachment ID. Use email-get first to get the attachment ID. The output provides EITHER temp_file_url (a file:// URL to the bytes on disk, returned when temp storage is available) OR content_base64 (base64-encoded file content, returned only when temp storage is unavailable) — never both, to stay under the output size limit. When content_base64 is present, pass it and content_type directly to file-parse for processing; when only temp_file_url is present, use it for binary-safe Drive uploads (see the temp_file_url output field). Enforces a 10 MB size limit.

inputs.attachment_id: string (Nylas attachment ID from email-get's attachments array)
inputs.message_id: string (Nylas message ID the attachment belongs to)
inputs.account: string? (named account to read from, as configured in channel_accounts.email. Defaults to the primary account.)

outputs.temp_file_url: string | undefined (file:// URL of the downloaded bytes on disk — for binary-safe Drive uploads, pass this as create_drive_file's fileUrl param and use the `filename` field as the file_name param to preserve the original attachment name)
outputs.content_base64: string | undefined (base64-encoded file content — only included when temp_file_url is unavailable, to avoid exceeding the skill output size limit)
